name: application-credit-card-form
title: Credit Card Form
description: Payment form with card number, expiry, and CVC fields, live brand-badge detection, and correct autocomplete attributes for browser and password-manager card fill.
useWhen: Collecting a credit or debit card for checkout or saving a payment method.
Showing a detected card brand badge as the user types their card number.
You want a live visual card preview reflecting the entered name, expiry, and last 4 digits.
avoidWhen: You use a hosted payment element (e.g. a PCI-compliant iframe field) — that field owns its own markup and should not be wrapped in a plain input like this.
Only a single stored payment method needs to be displayed, not entered — use a read-only card summary instead.
Brand detection logic isn't available — leave the brand prop as 'unknown' rather than guessing or hardcoding a badge.
responsiveBehavior: The form has a fixed max width suited to a checkout column; the expiry and CVC fields sit in a two-column grid that stacks on very narrow screens.
accessibility: Every field carries a real label and the correct autocomplete attribute (cc-number, cc-exp, cc-csc, cc-name) for browser and password-manager autofill.
The detected brand badge is supplementary — the card number itself remains the source of truth, not the badge.
The visual card preview in variant 2 is decorative (aria-hidden) since its content duplicates the real form fields below it.

variants.title: Standard form
variants.description: Vertical payment form with a card-number field showing a detected-brand badge, an expiry/CVC row, and a name field.
accessibility: Each field carries the matching cc-* autocomplete token so password managers can fill the form correctly.

variants.title: Standard form (Dark)
variants.description: Standard credit card form adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Field borders and label text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: With card preview
variants.description: Payment form with a live visual card preview above the fields, showing the masked number, name, and expiry.
accessibility: The decorative card preview is marked aria-hidden since its content duplicates the real, labeled form fields.

variants.title: With card preview (Dark)
variants.description: Card-preview payment form adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: The card preview's ring provides a visible edge against the dark form background.
